title: Barbers urges Roque: Return, no more reason to stay abroad

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque has been urged to return to the country and face the charges against him now that his bid for asylum in Austria was reportedly denied, former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers said on Tuesday. Barbers, in a press briefing on the sidelines of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, said that Roque no longer has an excuse to stay abroad. The former lawmaker said this after Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday said that the asylum bid of Roque, former spokesperson of ex-President Rodrigo Duterte, has been denied.
